sn4.20:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati himavantapasse araññakuṭikāyaṃ.
sn4.20:1.2: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi.
sn4.20:1.3: sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenāti.
sn4.20:2.1: atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn4.20:2.2: kāretu bhante bhagavā rajjaṃ, kāretu sugato rajjaṃ, ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenāti.
sn4.20:2.3: [bhagavā:] kimpana tvaṃ pāpima, passasi, yaṃ maṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadesi:
sn4.20:2.4: kāretu bhante bhagavā rajjaṃ, kāretu sugato rajjaṃ, ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ ajinaṃ ajāpayaṃ asocaṃ asocāpayaṃ dhammenāti.
sn4.20:2.5: [māro:] bhagavatā kho bhante cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā.
sn4.20:2.6: ākaṅkhamāno ca pana bhante bhagavā himavantaṃ pabbatarājaṃ suvaṇṇantveva adhimucceyya suvaṇṇapabbatassāti. [bhagavā:]
sn4.20:5.1: atha kho māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugatoti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti. rajavaggo
